name: Harding-Lee & Company
primary_cta: Write to <attorney> (prepared email naming the chosen office), or call the chosen office
brand_truth: Two islands, one senior practice: a Nassau and Salt Pond firm led since 1996 by a former Cash, Fountain partner who now chairs Bank of The Bahamas.
buyer: Bahamian families and business owners in Nassau and Long Island, overseas owners of Family Island property, institutions needing incorporation, banking or insurance counsel.

direction.why: A two-attorney boutique wins on 'a senior lawyer will take my matter', so the client's task is the hero, set in quiet book type; Bay Street pastel because the chambers sit in old Nassau.

concept_type: brochure: practice areas routed to the right attorney + offices + enquiry
tier_visual_why: A law firm wins on calm, type and light; 3D would read as a gimmick.
